title: A dramatic event at the end of the Ice Age wiped out North American megafauna

tellings.quote: I guarantee you that the North Atlantic ice cap and this dramatic event that that inst I say instantly but rapidly ended the ice age. I mean it eviscerated North America.

plain: A sudden, dramatic event linked to the North Atlantic ice cap ended the Ice Age quickly and "eviscerated" North America, wiping out its giant animals, according to a researcher of ancient sites named Luke Caverns. He tells it on Jesse Michels's show in 2025, citing an evolutionary biologist he does not name. If true, it would mean a catastrophe, not slow change, reshaped the continent at the end of the Ice Age.
